title.narrative: Qinghai Delingha Concentrated Solar Thermal Power Project

description.narrative: The proposed Qinghai Delinha Solar Thermal Plant Project (the Project) will construct 50 megawatt (MW) concentrating solar thermal power (CSP) plant in Qinghai Province. The Project is the first-of-its-kind utility scale CSP plant in the Peoples Republic of China (PRC). A project preparatory technical assistance (TA) will be undertaken for the due diligence of the Project.

Output: The construction of a first-of-its kind utility-scale CSP plant in Qinghai Province constructed Indicator: 50 MW parabolic trough CSP plant with 7 hours thermal storage capacity is commissioned and commercially operational by 2016 Achievement: 25 Progress/Status: Land levelling work has been completed since Nov 2014. CGN-SEDC proposed the engineering, procurement and constructon (EPC) procurement mode for key systems to mitigate technical risks and construction schedule management. Procurement of heat transfer fluid, molten salt, and solar field EPC have been completed. Construction progress at the site is currently on track. Heat transfer fluid, thermal energy storage, power block, and solar field (first 140 loops) subsystems have reached 90% progress as of Nov 2017. The plant started commercial testing in October 2018 and is expected to start commercial operations in May 2020. Data Source: Electric power yearbook of the PRC
